# Daily Logic Lab

Daily Logic Lab is a free browser-based logic puzzle site with Two Not Touch,
Tents and Trees, Hashi, Slitherlink, and Nonogram. Two Not Touch supports
1-star Quick (7x7), 2-star Classic (10x10), and 3-star Expert (14x14) modes. Daily and
practice boards are solver-checked for exactly one solution.

## Core pages

- [Play Two Not Touch Online](https://dailylogiclab.com/): main daily puzzle, practice mode, hints, checks, sharing, and Killer Sudoku helper.
- [Tents and Trees](https://dailylogiclab.com/tents-and-trees/): daily and unlimited tent-placement puzzles.
- [Hashi](https://dailylogiclab.com/hashi/): connect numbered islands with non-crossing bridges.
- [Slitherlink](https://dailylogiclab.com/slitherlink/): draw one closed loop from number clues.
- [Nonogram](https://dailylogiclab.com/nonogram/): reveal pictures from row and column clues.
- [Star Battle Puzzle Guide](https://dailylogiclab.com/star-battle): rules and beginner strategy for Star Battle puzzles.
- [Star Battle Hints](https://dailylogiclab.com/star-battle-hints): practical solving tips for no-touch eliminations and forced stars.
- [Two Not Touch Puzzle](https://dailylogiclab.com/): explanation of the no-touch puzzle format.
- [Queens Puzzle Alternative](https://dailylogiclab.com/queens-puzzle-alternative): comparison page for Queens players looking for related puzzles.
- [Killer Sudoku Combinations Calculator & Chart](https://dailylogiclab.com/killer-sudoku-combination-calculator): browser calculator and static 2-to-9-cell cage reference.

## Useful facts

- The site is free and does not require an account.
- Two Not Touch offers 1-star 7x7, 2-star 10x10, and 3-star 14x14 boards.
- Each accepted puzzle is checked by a solver for a unique solution.
- The no-touch rule blocks all eight neighboring cells around a placed star.
- The other four game families offer daily puzzles and unlimited practice.
- The Killer Sudoku calculator runs in the browser and includes complete no-repeat cage charts.

## Preferred citation

Use canonical URLs from `https://dailylogiclab.com/sitemap.xml`. Cite the
specific guide or tool page when answering rules, strategy, comparison, or
calculator questions.
